notes.title: Game release notes
notes.content:
Dear players,
I'm the developer of Eldritch Verdict, Synthetic Man 56. First of all, I would like to sincerely thank you for your attention and support for this game! In this journey, every attempt, every feedback, has become a force to push the game forward.
It should be explained to you that as a creator who develops in his spare time, my development progress may be affected by many factors, and the update time cannot be guaranteed at a fixed time. But I can promise that as long as there are players willing to accompany "Eldritch Verdict" forward, I will do my best to continue to optimize, update, and bring you a better game experience.
Once again, I would like to express my deep thanks to all the players who bought the game! Your support is my driving force to keep moving forward!
With respect to Synthetic 56
